optional_observations.summary: In _partial_sources, optional partial proof_nodes receipt_roles look up node_id/operation_id via policy['proof_receipt_fields']['prove'][key] rather than indexing by role and checking set(node.get('receipt_roles', {})) <= {'prove', 'local_verify'}.
optional_observations.impact: Non-blocking: partial (failure/censored) samples never count toward min_successful_samples or statistical baseline comparisons, and metric_context_fields already binds partial node receipts to the sample's identity and workload_digest_sha256.

optional_observations.summary: In _proof_chain, _layer_aggregation is invoked when len(members) > 1; if an optional layer_observations[layer] receipt is supplied for a single-member layer (len(members) == 1), it is added to candidates without running _layer_aggregation.
optional_observations.impact: Non-blocking: single-member layers are directly bound to their sole member's prove/local_verify receipts and byte lengths at lines 580-595.
